note: 這次查了 kotlinlang composing-suspending-functions(原始 md)、async KDoc、Android coroutines best practices、detekt coroutines 規則集(沒有 SequentialAsyncAwait 這個規則,該規則名查無)、JetBrains inspectopedia 搜尋。官方只有間接支持:async 的用途是並行(『doing both concurrently? This is where async comes to help』),以及 lazy 的 async 沒先 start 就 await 會『lead to sequential behavior』;沒有任何官方文字直接點名『async{}.await() 緊接』是壞寫法。另有反向風險:kotlinx.coroutines 的 GitHub issue 指出 IDE 建議把 async+await 換成 withContext 兩者並不完全等價(取消語意不同),所以標準寫法『直接呼叫或 withContext』要保守。找不到權威原文,不編。建議此規則降為提示或標註為推論。

quote: Returns an instance of Result that can be used to indicate that the work encountered a transient failure and should be retried with backoff specified in setBackoffCriteria.
note: ListenableWorker.Result 的 KDoc 定義 failure()=permanent failure、retry()=transient failure、success()=『the work completed successfully』;官方 Worker 範例在 catch IOException 時 return Result.failure()。這支持標準寫法(依錯誤回 failure/retry)與『失敗回 success 語意不符』。侷限:官方沒有一句話直接禁止『空 catch 後回 success』;壞寫法的『空 catch=例外被忽略』來自 detekt EmptyCatchBlock:『Empty catch blocks indicate that an exception is ignored and not handled.』兩者合起來成立,但屬語意推導而非明文禁令。

quote: If an exception is thrown, // catch and update the UI.
note: Android 官方 Flow 頁『Catching unexpected exceptions』的範例註解逐字為『Intermediate catch operator. If an exception is thrown, // catch and update the UI.』,並說明 catch 也可 emit 快取值。kotlinx KDoc 示範『caught exception can be replaced with some wrapper value for errors: flow.catch { e -> emit(ErrorWrapperValue(e)) }』與『If a particular exception does not need to be caught it can be rethrown from the action』。這些支持標準寫法(轉成錯誤狀態或 rethrow);官方沒有明文說『空 catch{} 是壞的』(KDoc 全文沒有 swallow 一詞),屬由正向建議推導。

quote: Defining the destination type is a more robust approach than passing a route string as in composable("profile").
note: Navigation 型別安全頁:『To access arguments from a type-safe route in a ViewModel, you can retrieve the route from the SavedStateHandle by calling SavedStateHandle.toRoute<T>()』,範例 class ProfileViewModel(savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle) { private val profile = savedStateHandle.toRoute<Profile>() },並稱型別化目的地比字串路由 more robust。支持標準寫法 toRoute<T>()。侷限:官方沒有明文說 get("…")!! 會 NPE 或禁止 !!;navArgs() 與『集中常數加預設值』兩個變體這次沒找到對應的官方原文,只有 toRoute 有。

『用索引找節點』這半沒找到官方明文反對。查了 Compose testing 的 apis、common-patterns、cheatsheet、semantics 頁(皆無 onChildAt/索引相關建議),以及 codelab。最接近的:codelab『Composables don't have IDs and you can't use the Node numbers shown in the tree to match them. If matching a node with its semantics properties is impractical or impossible, you can use the testTag modifier with the hasTestTag matcher as a last resort.』(講的是語意樹的節點編號,非 onAllNodes(...)[i] 集合索引,且把 testTag 列為最後手段而非首選),以及 onAllNodes KDoc『If you are working with elements that are not supposed to occur multiple times use onNode instead.』。結論:官方偏好語意匹配、testTag 是後備;『索引不穩』這個論點沒有權威原文。建議這半(kt-compose-test-node-by-index)改標推論或降級。
